narrative.overview: Operate mode preserves the existing checklist's restrained light palette and legible controls. The system feels practical and calm: cool paper surrounds white working surfaces, with dark text and a muted teal accent distinguishing interaction.
keyCharacteristics: Clear, compact controls with visible keyboard focus.
Borders and tonal surfaces define working areas.
Status labels accompany success and error color.
dos: Do retain readable labels alongside status color.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and the equivalent list editing path.
Do use tonal separation and borders for working surfaces.
donts: Don't treat all headings as a 24–32px scale; panel titles are 22px.
Don't apply modal shadows to ordinary working surfaces.
